content.text: On the escalation on-call page, choosing "Mute SMS for this shift" also silences Slack and email pages. Engineers who only wanted to stop SMS during a meeting missed Slack page storms and email digests.

Mute should flip sms_muted=true on the shift record and leave slack_muted / email_muted unchanged. Observed: the toggle writes muted_channels=["sms","slack","email"] because the UI reuses the "mute all" payload shape with a single boolean.
Backend already supports per-channel flags; only the on-call settings form collapses them.

description_text:
On the escalation on-call page, choosing "Mute SMS for this shift" also silences Slack and email pages. Engineers who only wanted to stop SMS during a meeting missed Slack page storms and email digests.
Mute should flip sms_muted=true on the shift record and leave slack_muted / email_muted unchanged. Observed: the toggle writes muted_channels=["sms","slack","email"] because the UI reuses the "mute all" payload shape with a single boolean.
Backend already supports per-channel flags; only the on-call settings form collapses them.
